en: Monochrome reproduction of a painting showing a two‑storey rectangular building along a curved road or square, with trees surrounding it. The building carries a large flag on a tall pole at the roof ridge. In front are people walking, a child with a dog, and a horse‑drawn carriage. The scene appears 19th‑century, semi‑rural or small‑town European. The image is bordered like an old printed card, with worn corners but no visible writing on the front.
